title: A joint resolution providing for the appointment of John Fahey as a citizen regent of the Board of Regents of the Smithsonian Institution.
official_summary:
(This measure has not been amended since it was introduced. The summary of that version is repeated here.)

Appoints John Fahey as a citizen regent of the Board of Regents of the Smithsonian Institution.

summary.headline: This resolution appoints John Fahey as a citizen regent on the Smithsonian Institution's Board of Regents.
summary.what_it_does: Public Law 113-84 is a joint resolution that names John Fahey as a citizen regent of the Board of Regents of the Smithsonian Institution. The Smithsonian is a federal museum and research group, and its Board of Regents oversees it. The official summary does not describe any other duties, rules, or funding changes.

who_it_affects.how: He is named to serve as a citizen regent on the Smithsonian's Board of Regents.

who_it_affects.group: The Smithsonian Institution's Board of Regents
who_it_affects.how: The board gains one citizen member through this appointment.

summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on February 21, 2014. The official summary does not give a separate effective date.
